title: The Truth of the Turtle Shell
next_chapter_hook: The turtle shell star chart also displayed a line of text—'The second key has awakened, the fourth possibility opens from here.'

text.content:
Chen Ji's fingertip hovered above the cover of that crumbling ancient text.

That name was like a red-hot iron needle, violently piercing his pupils—even through the yellowed paper, he could seemingly feel that pressure spanning ten thousand years. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul trembled beside him, and an unprecedented fear actually appeared on that blurred face.

"Teacher..." Chen Ji's voice was hoarse as sandpaper, "Do you recognize this person?"

Mo Xiansheng remained silent for a long while before speaking: "Recognize? That's an understatement." His voice seemed to come from an ancient well, impossibly deep, "He was... the first master of the Tianji Record, and the originator who bound our fates to the same chain."

Chen Ji slowly tucked that list into his sleeve but didn't immediately inquire about the meaning of that name. His gaze passed over Mo Xiansheng's illusory form and landed on the turtle shell divine artifact resting silently on the altar.

This object had accompanied him for over a decade, hanging around his neck since he could remember. His mother said on her deathbed that it was a family heirloom of the Chen family, capable of protecting his safety. Ironic—precisely this 'peace talisman' had made him a target—people of Tianqing Sect thought he harbored some earth-shattering secret, not knowing even he himself was unaware of this secret.

"Teacher," Chen Ji suddenly spoke, his tone unnaturally calm, "You said the core area of the Tianji Record cannot be opened without sufficient Heavenly Fate. What if I used all my Heavenly Fate?"

Mo Xiansheng's expression changed drastically: "Are you mad? Using all your Heavenly Fate means—"

"Means I might die." Chen Ji finished his sentence, a faint, detached curve forming at the corner of his mouth, "But if I don't go mad this once, I won't even know how I died."

He raised his hand and removed the turtle shell divine artifact from his neck—the warm, smooth touch had never changed over thousands of years. Then he made a move that made Mo Xiansheng's soul shatter—he directly pressed the turtle shell against the core area of the Tianji Record.

A thunderous roar echoed.

That palm-sized turtle shell actually unfurled like a living creature, and a brilliant starlight burst forth from within, instantly illuminating the entire secret chamber!

dialogue.content:
"Chen Ji!" Mo Xiansheng's roar exploded in his mind, but he couldn't spare a moment to respond. That starlight transformed into countless light points, slowly outlining a vast, boundless star chart in the void. That star chart was not static—the river of stars flowed, celestial bodies rotated, as if narrating billions of years of vicissitudes of a certain realm.

Chen Ji stared intently at the very center of that star chart, where he saw an incomparably familiar outline—the very shape of the turtle shell itself. And surrounding the turtle shell, three chain-like patterns wound around it layer upon layer, with the other ends of those chains extending toward three entirely different directions.

"The Three Realms..." Chen Ji murmured, his pupils constricting sharply, "This is a positional map of the Three Realms!"

text.content:
Just then, an aged yet majestic voice rang out from the depths of the star chart—not belonging to Mo Xiansheng, but from an even more ancient, even more transcendent existence:

"Dimension coordinate anchor activated. Bloodline key verification in progress... Verification passed. First Observer's bequest initiated."

Chen Ji felt a burning sensation in his chest—that birthmark he had never noticed—the golden turtle-shell-shaped mark, now frantically flickering with a light that resonated with some switch in the depths of his bloodline.

The star chart abruptly transformed, and those three chains began to tremble violently. Immediately afterward, a scene rushed into Chen Ji's consciousness like a tide—

It was a void he had never seen before. Not belonging to the Three Realms, not belonging to the Demonic Realm, not even belonging to any place in his cognition. There was no division between heaven and earth, only endless grayish-white mist and the occasional eerie fissures tearing through the mist.

And in the deepest part of the mist, a figure cloaked in dark robes stood with their back to him. Countless light points surrounded that figure, each light point being a seal, firmly locking down the constantly writhing fissures.

"I am the First Observer of the Tianji Record." The figure spoke, his voice clear despite穿越 ten thousand years, "Today, using the turtle shell as the lock and bloodline as the key, I have sealed the high-dimensional invaders here. I shall remain here, using my body as the anchor, until the seal is eternally fixed."

dialogue.content:
Chen Ji's entire body shuddered violently, and countless thoughts flashed through his mind like lightning.

That back... that seal... and the four words 'bloodline as the key'!

He abruptly lowered his head to look at the turtle-shell birthmark on his chest, then at the turtle shell divine artifact that had already unfolded into a star chart in his hand—a terrifying conjecture exploded like thunder:

"I am not the guardian of the seal..." His voice trembled, "I am the key that opens the seal!"

Mo Xiansheng's figure fluctuated intensely, seemingly wanting to say something, but that aged voice interrupted again:

"Chen descendant, the blood flowing within you is precisely that of the one who originally arranged the seal. The turtle shell has recognized its master, meaning the key is ready. When the time comes, you may choose—"

"Shut up!" Chen Ji erupted in a sudden roar, shaking the walls, "I don't want any choices!"

text.content:
The star chart seemed oblivious to his fury, the scene continuing to advance. Chen Ji saw that robed figure slowly turn around, revealing their true appearance—a face bearing three-tenths resemblance to his own, yet aged as if witnessing the birth and destruction of the universe.

"My descendant," the voice softened somewhat, "Do not be afraid. A key is not limited to only unlocking."

The scene transformed again, and Chen Ji saw that those three chains were not unidirectional—their other ends connected to the robed figure's heart. With every heartbeat, wisps of power were drawn from that heart, transforming into nourishment for the seal.

"I used my body as the lock core; the seal cannot be opened without me." The figure stated, "But your bloodline holds another power—if you choose to reinforce the seal, I can transfer all my remaining power to you, allowing you to replace me as the new lock core; if you choose to open the seal..."

The scene abruptly darkened.

Chen Ji witnessed another aspect—the Three Realms after the seal's collapse. The galaxy inverted, the earth cracked, and countless unnameable entities pouring from the fissures swallowed everything like a tide. Tianqing Sect, Xuanwu Sect, Holy Sect of the Demonic Path... all life was reduced to dust in an instant.

And at the center of that destruction, a familiar figure stood proudly—it was himself. But that 'Chen Ji' was surrounded by eerie gray mist, his eyes devoid of any human emotion.

"If you open the seal," the aged voice finally stated, "You will become the new vessel for the high-dimensional will. The Heavenly Eye has waited for this moment for ten thousand years."

Chen Ji's entire body turned cold, as if falling into an abyss.

The star chart slowly gathered, reforming into the turtle shell's shape and falling into Chen Ji's palm. But that aged voice did not disappear, echoing long in the secret chamber:

"The First Observer did not ascend; he voluntarily transformed into part of the seal. He scattered the key within the bloodline, waiting for a descendant powerful enough to appear—either to reinforce the seal, or to open it, or..."

"Or what?" Chen Ji asked hoarsely.

"Or to find that fourth possibility." The voice gradually faded, leaving only one sentence that made Chen Ji's spine chill, "But observing your fate, you are destined to have a deadly劫 with the Heavenly Eye. Either you devour it, or it devours you—there is no third path."

dialogue.content:
The secret chamber fell into deathly silence.

Mo Xiansheng's figure drifted before Chen Ji; that always indifferent face revealed a complex expression for the first time: "Chen Ji... do you understand what this means?"

Chen Ji didn't answer, merely lowering his gaze to stare at the turtle shell in his hand. The warm touch remained, but now held in his palm, it weighed heavier than ten thousand junns.

"It means I'm a goddamn time bomb." He suddenly laughed, that smile more tragic than crying, "No matter what I choose, I'm pushing the Three Realms into the fire pit. Reinforce the seal, I have to be that lock core, trapped in that void of nothingness until the end of time; open the seal, I'll be possessed by that Heavenly Eye, becoming the executioner who destroys the Three Realms."

He abruptly raised his head, his eyes blazing with terrifying light: "That old geezer could foresee all this—why the hell did he pass this烂摊子 to me?!"

text.content:
Mo Xiansheng remained silent for a long while before slowly speaking: "Because he was an Observer. The Observer's mission was never to make choices for the world, but to hand the power of choice to those who come after."

"What a magnificent, high-sounding excuse." Chen Ji coldly laughed, "Shirk all responsibility, leaving us descendants to wipe their butt."

He violently slammed the turtle shell onto the altar, producing a dull, thunderous crash. The turtle shell remained unscathed, but the altar shattered into pieces.

"Chen Ji!" Mo Xiansheng sharply rebuked, "Be calm!"

"I'm very calm." Chen Ji's tone actually calmed down strangely—that was the calm before a storm, "I'm thinking about how to dead-end this path."

He turned to look at Mo Xiansheng, his eyes flashing with dangerous light: "Teacher, you said I'm the key. What if... the key itself is destroyed?"

dialogue.content:
Mo Xiansheng's expression instantly turned ashen: "You're insane! Bloodline is bound to soul—destroying the key equals—"

"Equals me dying." Chen Ji finished for him, a mocking arc curving at his lips, "I know. But a dead person can't unlock anything, right?"

"You—"

"I'm kidding." Chen Ji suddenly shifted topics, his demeanor returning to its usual carefree appearance, "Chen Ji hasn't lived enough yet—how could I bear to die?"

He picked up the turtle shell again, examining it carefully, then suddenly asked: "That First Observer... what was his name?"

choice.prompt: Mo Xiansheng seemed to be hesitating whether to speak that name. Chen Ji waited, an odd premonition stirring in his heart—that name might completely change his understanding of his own bloodline.

choices.description: Actively request Mo Xiansheng to seal his bloodline power through secret methods, eliminating the possibility of becoming the key—even if this means forever losing part of the Tianji Record's abilities.
choices.visible_cost: Losing Part of the Tianji Record's Abilities
choices.visible_reward: Breaking Free from the Key Identity's Control
choices.risk_hint: Sealing the bloodline may affect Combat Power, and Mo Xiansheng may not agree

text.content:
Mo Xiansheng deeply gazed at Chen Ji, those illusory eyes flickering with intertwined light of approval and worry: "Sealing the bloodline... this method isn't impossible, but do you know the cost?"

Chen Ji stared directly at him, words clear and每个字砸在地上: "Compared to being a key, I more fear being a criminal."

choices.description: Since fate insists on making him the key, then turn the tables—utilize the key identity to gain more complete power of the Tianji Record, accumulating capital for the final decisive battle.
choices.visible_cost: May be Locked On by the Heavenly Eye
choices.visible_reward: Unlocking the Deeper Powers of the Tianji Record
choices.risk_hint: The closer to the key's core, the stronger the surveillance of the Heavenly Dao's Eye

text.content: Chen Ji gripped the turtle shell in his palm and closed his eyes: "Since I can't escape, then I'll face it head-on. Does that Heavenly Dao's Eye think it can use me as a vessel? Let's see who ends up being devoured in the end." The turtle shell warmed slightly, as if responding to his will. Mo Xiansheng seemed about to speak, but ultimately just sighed.

choices.description: Neither sealing nor utilizing, but actively exploring that "Fourth Possibility" — since the first Observer left these words, it means a third path must definitely exist.
choices.visible_cost: Requiring vast time and resources to explore the unknown
choices.visible_reward: Possibly finding a method to reverse fate
choices.risk_hint: Before finding the third path, must simultaneously guard against seal collapse and the Heavenly Dao's Eye

text.content: Chen Ji suddenly smiled, a composure that comes from seeing through the entire game: "Since that old fellow could say 'Fourth Possibility', it means he left me a path long ago. The question is only... whether I can find it." He opened the Tianji Record, his gaze falling on those fragmented pages: "Master, how much do you know about the other traces the Observer left behind?"

Mo Xiansheng's form trembled violently, as if this name had stirred memories buried for countless ages. His voice emerged with extreme difficulty, each word seemingly draining all his strength: "His name was... Chen Tianming." Chen Ji froze. Not because the name was unfamiliar, but because it was deeply familiar. "Chen... Tianming?" His voice quivered. "Same surname as me?" Mo Xiansheng closed his eyes, seemingly unwilling to meet his gaze: "More than just the same surname. Chen Ji, do you think where the surname 'Chen' came from?" A thunderous explosion rang in Chen Ji's mind. An ancient ancestral blood memory flooded forth like a deluge — a scene of an ancient tribe's sacrificial ritual, where his progenitor led clan members through harsh wilderness survival. A figure draped in dark robes descended from the heavens as an Observer, placing a turtle shell into his ancestor's hands: "'Chen' means formation. Formations exist to distribute Heavenly Secrets. From this day forth, your clan shall serve as the formation's eye for the seal, eternally guarding this object until the key fulfills its karmic destiny."

Chen Ji stood frozen, paralyzed as if struck by lightning. So this was the truth. His bloodline was never a random occurrence, but a deliberate design — the Chen family's sole purpose was to cultivate him as this "key." His father's disappearance, mother's illness, sister's abduction... Were these tragedies orchestrated by some invisible hand? "Heh..." Chen Ji suddenly let out a low, hoarse laugh, filled with inexplicable sarcasm. "So I was never the chosen one. From birth, I was a sacrificial offering kept in a cage." "Chen Ji!" Mo Xiansheng barked. "Don't be deceived!" "I'm not." Chen Ji raised his head, his rage slowly transforming into something far more terrifying — an ice-cold killing intent. "I was simply contemplating how to settle this account if that ancestor Chen Tianming still exists..."

dialogue.content: Just then, the turtle shell hummed again. Chen Ji glanced down to see the star chart had re-expanded, and in the corner of the chart, a line of never-before-seen text was slowly appearing: "The second key has awakened. The Fourth Possibility opens from here." Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply. "A second key? Is there another person besides me?" Mo Xiansheng's expression turned extremely grim; even that虚幻 face displayed unprecedented terror: "This is impossible... There's only one key, and that's you. Unless..." "Unless what?" Mo Xiansheng's voice reached the limits of hardship: "Unless someone used some forbidden technique to replicate your bloodline characteristics."

text.content: Countless images flashed through Chen Ji's mind like lightning. Chen Nian — his missing sister, taken by the Holy Sect as the "Heavenly Fate Lock-Key"! If those madmen of the Holy Sect truly researched a method to replicate bloodlines... "Chen Nian..." His voice was terrifyingly low. "What did they do to her?" Mo Xiansheng remained silent, but that silence itself was the answer. Chen Ji rose abruptly, his aura surging violently. The air in the secret chamber seemed to evaporate, the walls groaning under the pressure. "I'm going to the Holy Sect." His voice was terrifyingly calm. "Now." "Calm yourself!" Mo Xiansheng shouted. "With your current strength, going to the Holy Sect is no different from suicide!" "Then let them see," Chen Ji slowly turned, his eyes glowing like万年寒冰, "how sharp this key they've raised truly is."

The turtle shell's star chart slowly dissolved, the final glimmer sinking into Chen Ji's palm. The chamber returned to darkness, save for the faint glow from the turtle shell birthmark on his chest. Chen Ji drew a deep breath, forcing himself to calm down. He couldn't act rashly. Not yet. Whether Chen Nian truly had her bloodline replicated still required verification; the Holy Sect's true intentions still needed investigation; and his own key power within... He gazed at his hands, sensing the dormant force stirring in his blood. This power was both curse and opportunity — the key lay in how he wielded it. "Mo Xiansheng." He suddenly spoke, his voice recovered its usual tranquility. "If I choose to become the lock core... what must I do?" Mo Xiansheng's form trembled violently: "You... what are you saying?" "I'm asking you," Chen Ji raised his head, a meaningful smile curling his lips, "if I choose to inherit that ancestor's will, what must I do?"

Mo Xiansheng gazed at Chen Ji for a long time, as if trying to discern something from his eyes. After a long while, he sighed deeply: "Very well. Since your resolve is set, this old man will tell you." "To become the lock core requires three things: the turtle shell artifact's complete acknowledgment, the Tianji Record's complete unity, and..." "And what?" Mo Xiansheng's voice became unprecedentedly grave: "And a co-fate individual willing to bear the Heavenly Fate's backlash on your behalf." Chen Ji's heart sank heavily. "Co-fate individual..." "Correct. The lock core's power is vast and immense; a mortal body cannot withstand it. There must be another person voluntarily sharing this power, their fates intertwined, living and dying together." Mo Xiansheng gazed at him, eyes flickering with complex emotions. "This is also why this old man has been encouraging you..." He didn't finish, but Chen Ji already understood. Su Qingyao. That woman who had persistently tried to investigate him, yet was deflected three times. That beauty who could unlock the "Co-Fate" buff when affinity was maxed. So everything had been arranged from much earlier on.
